BiblicalUsage: Only once does this word occur, and it says something the whole psalm keeps saying. In Psalm 119:96 the psalmist has seen an end of all perfection, a limit to every finished thing, while God's commandment is exceeding broad, with no such end.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the psalm draws the line exactly there: everything human reaches its limit, and only God's word goes on without one.
